abstract:
CSOAI publishes a signed, open-source AI measurement board. The GSPC board measures AI behaviour across 22 axes (14 model-comparison + 8 deterministic-fact). Every measurement is signed under did:web:csoai.org#card-attestation-1 (Ed25519) and witnessed in Sigstore Rekor. Bitcoin anchoring via OpenTimestamps is planned: a stamp is not an anchor, and we will report the anchored count only once calendars commit the stamps to blocks.

OUTCOME: a 4-anchor machine that gives the EU AI Office, member state regulators (ICO, CNIL, BfK, AgID, AESIA), insurers (Lloyd's syndicates, Munich Re, Zurich), and vendors (Meta, Mistral, OpenAI, Anthropic) an independently verifiable measurement substrate for AI compliance - without trusting any single party.

Deliverable: signed cards + OSCAL evidence bundles + A2A/MCP/x402 doors that any agent can read.
experience:
Yes. CSOAI (Council of AI) is the independent AI-governance measurement body I have built and run since 2025. The company is incorporated as CSOAI Ltd (UK 16939677).

PAST CONTRIBUTIONS:
- The 22-axis GSPC measurement board (Governance, Safety, Provenance, Continuity)
- The signed card-v0 attestation format (canonical JSON, Ed25519, 3KB or less)
- The measurement anchor stack: HuggingFace, Sigstore Rekor and a public corrections
  ledger, all live; Bitcoin OpenTimestamps is the planned fourth
- Published Python and npm packages across the measurement, agent-configuration
  and OS product lines
- The MCP server csoai-gspc-mcp on npm
- A2A agent card + x402 priced attestation rail + C2PA Article 50 detector
- Open contributions to the IETF SCITT WG (issue #13, conformance test vectors)
- The corrections ledger (public-write, anyone can append)
use:
EUR 50,000 over 12 weeks:

1. ECP integration (EUR 20K, 6 weeks): every CSOAI card signed with an Ed25519 key from the European Cryptographic Profile.

2. OTel-to-corrections pipeline (EUR 20K, 6 weeks): every AI agent runtime telemetry becomes a signed correction ledger entry. This is what Iman asked for in issue #2 of the IETF SCITT working group.

3. Decentralised corrections ledger (EUR 10K, 4 weeks): migrate from a single-writer API to a multi-writer IPFS-pinned append-only structure. Today the corrections ledger is at /api/corrections; tomorrow it has to be IPFS-pinned so any party can hold the chain.
comparison:
There are no comparable open-source projects that combine:
- A signed measurement board, each card verifiable against a published DID key (vs unsigned benchmarks like EleutherAI's lm-evaluation-harness or MLCommons)
- A public corrections ledger (vs private vendor QA loops)
- Three independent live anchors — HuggingFace, Sigstore Rekor and a public corrections
  ledger (vs single-anchor solutions like IPFS CIDs or Arweave only)
- A permissionless RaaS over x402 (vs SaaS seats with Stripe)

The closest analogue is the model-transparency (model-signing) project from OpenSSF, but it signs the model files, not the measurement results. We sign the measurement results. The substrate is the substrate of AI governance, not the artifact.
challenges:
The hardest part of the work is the doctrinal discipline: we must NEVER invent a measurement we did not actually make. The doctrine (measurement, not certification; anyone can re-check; UNCHECKABLE is honest) is the moat.

The second-hardest part is the forge-of-trust between the issuer (the operator) and the verifier (anyone): a signed card must be verifiable offline, with no phone-home, no API call. The /gspc-verify portal uses WebCrypto in the browser.

The third is the metered rail - every priced artefact is metered by x402 over USDC on Base, no Stripe, no accounts. The ONE click that unlocks settlement is X402_FACILITATOR_URL=https://facilitator.payai.network.
ecosystem:
The corrections ledger is the public-write part: anyone can submit a correction in plain English, signed under CSOAI public key, and added to the ledger with full provenance. Affected communities, journalists, regulators, vendors - anyone can dispute a measurement.

The board is free. The corrections ledger is free. The verification is free. The metered rail (issuance, evidence bundles, data feeds, proof bundles, custom audits) is priced in USDC on Base.

The HuggingFace org csoai carries 60+ datasets + 42 Spaces. The Chrome extension + Grok plugin + Hermes skill + MCP server reach developers, journalists, and regulators without a per-user account.
ai_prompt:
Used CSOAI own LLM substrate (HuggingFace Mistral-7B-Instruct + Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) for first-draft text. All text reviewed and edited by Nicholas Templeman. The grading/scoring/measurement was NOT done by any LLM - every measurement is deterministic-facts or frozen-item-bank model-comparison.

No proprietary text was generated. The grant draft is human-written in collaboration with the operator own CLI agent (Hermes desktop, MiniMax-M3).
